CLASSIFICATION_RULE: TF-SEED0001-RD-RETRO1 is classified INCONCLUSIVE_DISCOVERY whatever the outcome statistics, because its frozen feasibility verdict is INCONCLUSIVE_SAMPLE / BELOW_HARD_FLOOR. The gates below are evaluated mechanically and reported as exploratory only.
PROSPECTIVE_LEG: TF-SEED0001-RD-PROSP1 stays separate, frozen and not activated. Nothing seen in this exploratory pass may modify its definitions.
EPISODE_SET_RULE: Outcomes are computed only for the episodes in the frozen CSVs, verified by SHA256 and episode digest. No episode is added, removed or regenerated; the 36 BTC Arm-A episodes are used as frozen.
PRICE_SOURCE: pinned Binance UM 1m klines 2022-11..2024-12 (objects verified against DATASET_MANIFEST.json); every window ends by 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z; no 2025/2026 byte is read

PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.ENTRY: E = ENTRY_REF_PRICE (close of bar i+3, the decision price at T)
PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.STOP: S = STOP_PRICE (low_i); stop event = first 1m bar with open time in [T, T + cap) whose low < S
PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.TARGET: target event = first 1m bar with open time in [T, T + cap) whose high >= E + k R
PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.SAME_MINUTE: stop and target in the same minute count as the stop
PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.Y: Yk_cap = 1 if the target event is strictly first, else 0 (stop first, same minute, or timeout)
PREREGISTERED_BRACKET.MISSING_MINUTE: an episode with any missing minute in [T, T + cap) is UNAVAILABLE for that endpoint (timestamps only)

OUTCOME_DEFINITIONS.WIN_LOSS_NEUTRAL: per endpoint: WIN = target first; LOSS = stop first or same minute; NEUTRAL = neither within the cap (timeout)

DESCRIPTIVE_DEFINED_IN_THIS_PERMIT_BEFOR.NOTE: Requested by the owner; not preregistered endpoints; descriptive only; never used for any gate
DESCRIPTIVE_DEFINED_IN_THIS_PERMIT_BEFOR.FWD_RET_h: C_h / E - 1, with C_h the close of the 1m bar whose open time is T + h - 1 minute
DESCRIPTIVE_DEFINED_IN_THIS_PERMIT_BEFOR.MFE_R_h: (max 1m high over open times [T, T + h) - E) / R, over the full window regardless of stop or target
DESCRIPTIVE_DEFINED_IN_THIS_PERMIT_BEFOR.MAE_R_h: (E - min 1m low over open times [T, T + h)) / R, over the full window regardless of stop or target

ANALYSIS_PLAN.PRIMARY_AS_PREREGISTERED: BTC, Y1_48H ~ 1 + A + B + C (D reference) + log RV24 + sin(2 pi hour/24) + cos(2 pi hour/24) + DECLINE_ATR + NETFLOW24 + RISK_ATR; OLS (linear probability); CR1 cluster-robust variance with weekly clusters (WEEK_BLOCK), t reference on G - 1 df; P1 = beta_A - beta_B, P2 = beta_A - beta_C; two-sided p; Holm over {P1, P2} at 0.05

INTERVALS.CR1_T: 95% CI = estimate +- t(0.975, G - 1) x CR1 SE
INTERVALS.WEEK_CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP: pairs bootstrap over whole weekly clusters, 4999 resamples, numpy default_rng seed 20261004, percentile 95% CI of P1 and P2 from the same model; resamples with an absent arm or a singular design are skipped and counted

GATES_REPORTED_MECHANICALLY.STATISTICAL: Holm rejects both P1 and P2 and both estimates are positive
GATES_REPORTED_MECHANICALLY.PRACTICAL: both adjusted risk differences >= 0.10, and the adjusted A rate (mean fitted value over all eligible episodes with the arm set to A) >= mean over A episodes of 0.5 + (0.0010 / RISK_FRACTION) / 2
GATES_REPORTED_MECHANICALLY.ROLE: reported for transparency; cannot change CLASSIFICATION_FIXED_BEFORE_OUTCOMES

SECONDARY_AS_PREREGISTERED: S4 Y1_48H P1/P2 with 48h overlap-chain clusters (CHAIN_48H)
raw arm rates (arm-only model, CR1 weekly) and A vs D
ANALYSIS_PLAN.DESCRIPTIVE: per arm and endpoint: WIN/LOSS/NEUTRAL counts; per arm: mean and median of FWD_RET_h, FWD_R_h, MFE_R_h, MAE_R_h at 48h and 96h; A minus B and A minus C differences of the means from an arm-only OLS with CR1 weekly clusters and t(G - 1) 95% CI

EPOCHS.ROLE: descriptive robustness only, never a selection rule; the feasibility pass recorded the epoch gate NOT_ASSESSABLE, so it cannot fail the card
EPOCHS.EPOCH_ESTIMATE: within-epoch OLS of Y1_48H on arm dummies only, CR1 by week, P1 and P2 with t(G_e - 1) 95% CI
EPOCHS.HETEROGENEITY_TEST_AS_PREREGISTERED: Q = sum_e (theta_e - theta_w)^2 / se_e^2 against a block permutation of whole weekly clusters across epochs (week counts per epoch kept), seed 20261003, 2000 draws
EPOCHS.OPPOSITE_SIGN_TEST_AS_PREREGISTERED: an epoch estimate with the sign opposite to the pooled estimate and one-sided p < 0.05
EPOCHS.SIGN_CONSISTENCY: number of epochs whose P1 and P2 point estimates share the pooled sign

ANALYSIS_PLAN.ETH: identical model and plan run separately on the frozen ETH episodes; robustness only; never pooled; cannot change anything about BTC

FORBIDDEN_AFTER_OUTCOMES: any threshold, horizon, stop, entry or exit change
any subgroup selection or regime filter
any new clustering or inference method presented as primary
any change to the prospective preregistration
a later variant is a new research object / SEED with its own TEST_FAMILY_ID
ORDER: this permit is committed first; the evaluator is implemented and tested on synthetic paths and committed second; only then is it run once on the frozen episodes
